construction: Locally authored LibreDWG 0.14 R13/R14 controls remap ACAD APPID from 0x12 to unused 0x33, update the APPID_CONTROL member, owner, EED handle and handseed, and verify peer JSON readback. UTF-8 variants patch a fixed-size EED string and repair the verified object CRC. No generated files are committed.
checks: The observer checks the single physically referenced APPID handle against its immutable source record, live unique handle, exact ACAD name, bound source text profile and staged output-table identity.

The alternate-handle R14 EED-free baseline passes strict conversion. Before the change, its EED variant was refused at opaque-output qualification; after the change, ASCII and UTF-8 controls pass R14 strict and R13 explicit-partial output.

ASan tests cover both source versions, two APPID handles, EED values, APPID changes, source-bit mutations, late failure, destination preservation, same-adapter retry and unrepresentable UTF-8 refusal.
ezdxf 1.4.5 independently reads ACAD, café and integer 42 from the alternate-handle ASCII and Binary outputs for each version.
limits: The bounded group and root source handles remain fixed; broader graph admission requires a separately checked remapped group/NOD witness.
This does not qualify strict R13, unobserved EED schemas, arbitrary APPID names, native clone semantics or general DWG/DXF support.
